summary.business_type: B2B service studio / agency — trilingual (EN/DE/ES), lead-generation, no e-commerce, no pricing, no blog
top_findings: Canonical domain renovostudio.com serves a registrar parking page, not the site — zero indexable presence today
Impressum and privacy policy render bracketed placeholders in production HTML in all three languages (§ 5 DDG mandatory fields)
Personal Gmail address is the studio's public contact in 43 mailto links, both legal pages and the ProfessionalService schema
Testimonial renders empty (quote: '') — the site's only social-proof slot is blank
ProfessionalService schema lacks logo, image, telephone and complete PostalAddress
quick_wins: Preload the latin woff2 subset — currently discovered only after 53.7KB of CSS parses
Add sizes to the 39 responsive images — srcset without sizes makes the browser assume 100vw
noindex the 404 page and drop its canonical, hreflang and schema (it duplicates the homepage title and description)
Add lastmod to the 36 sitemap URLs — the data already exists as WebSite.dateModified
Add xhtml:link hreflang alternates to the sitemap

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Self-referencing absolute canonical on all 37 pages
hreflang en/de/es/x-default on 36/37 pages — all self-referencing, all reciprocal, no dangling targets
Localized slugs (/de/ki-assistent/, /es/rediseno-web/) correctly cross-linked
robots.txt clean with absolute Sitemap pointer
Zero broken internal links across 901 anchors; zero orphan pages
Zero third-party hosts in markup — no Google Fonts, no analytics, no tag managers
Interim GitHub Pages deploy correctly noindex/nofollow with no sitemap

findings.title: Canonical domain serves a registrar parking page
findings.description: https://renovostudio.com/ returns a 114-byte openresty-served JS redirect to /lander, publishing its own competing robots.txt, llms.txt (Disallow-Training: /) and a sitemap.xml containing only https://renovostudio.com/lander. Every canonical, og:url, hreflang and schema @id in the build asserts this domain.
findings.recommendation: Deploy dist/ to Cloudflare Pages or Vercel, point DNS, drop GITHUB_PAGES=true, and confirm the parking page's robots.txt/llms.txt/sitemap.xml are gone.

findings.title: Sitemap has no lastmod
findings.description: sitemap-0.xml lists 36 URLs with no lastmod, changefreq or priority. lastmod is the element Google actually consumes, and the data already exists as WebSite.dateModified (2026-08-07).
findings.recommendation: Configure @astrojs/sitemap to emit lastmod per entry.

findings.title: Sitemap omits xhtml:link hreflang alternates
findings.description: For a 3-language site, per-entry hreflang annotation in the sitemap is Google's recommended reinforcement of in-page hreflang. Currently absent.
findings.recommendation: Enable the @astrojs/sitemap i18n option to emit xhtml:link alternates.

findings.title: 404 page is treated as a real indexable page
findings.description: /404.html carries a canonical (…/404/), full hreflang, and ProfessionalService + WebSite schema, and duplicates the homepage's exact title and meta description. Its three hreflang entries are the audit's only non-reciprocal ones. It is correctly excluded from the sitemap and has zero inbound links.
findings.recommendation: Add meta robots noindex, give it a unique title, and drop the canonical, hreflang and schema.

findings.title: No security headers on the current host
findings.description: The live deploy sends only strict-transport-security. content-security-policy, x-content-type-options, referrer-policy and permissions-policy are absent. GitHub Pages cannot set headers.
findings.recommendation: Ship a _headers file on the new host; the CSP must allow the chat worker origin once PUBLIC_CHAT_ENDPOINT is set.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: No duplicate titles or descriptions anywhere except the 404/homepage pair
Unique, specific, plain-language copy — no filler, no keyword stuffing
Full trilingual parity: all 12 page types in EN/DE/ES with real translations
Case studies are honest and scope-accurate
Named, verifiable clients with outbound links; founder named and linked to GitHub + LinkedIn

findings.title: Legal pages ship bracketed placeholders in production HTML
findings.description: Rendered and user-visible in all three languages: [Street and number], [Postcode] Fürth, [VAT ID], 'Telephone: [required — a phone number or an equally direct channel must be given]', 'This website is hosted by [hosting provider, address].' and [address as in the imprint]. A full postal address and direct contact channel are mandatory under § 5 DDG.
findings.recommendation: Fill all TODO-CONTENT fields in src/data/{en,de,es}.ts; confirm the supervisory-authority line matches the registered business address.

findings.title: Personal Gmail is the studio's public identity
findings.description: axelbraunschweiger@gmail.com appears in 43 mailto: links, the Impressum, the privacy policy and the ProfessionalService schema email field. A free consumer mailbox undercuts B2B positioning at the point of conversion.
findings.recommendation: Set studio.email in src/lib/i18n.ts to a domain address (e.g. hello@renovostudio.com); all 43 references follow from that single source.

findings.title: Testimonial renders empty
findings.description: testimonial: { quote: '', attribution: '' } in all three data files. The component ships but displays nothing — the site's only social-proof slot is blank.
findings.recommendation: Add one real, attributed client quote.

findings.title: Thin work-index pages
findings.description: Nine pages under 400 words. Contact pages being short is expected; the misses are the work indexes — /work/ (335w), /de/projekte/ (294w), /es/proyectos/ (354w) — which are the natural landing pages for portfolio-intent queries but carry almost no text around the two case-study cards.
findings.recommendation: Add an intro framing how the studio works and what a project looks like; pair with CollectionPage + ItemList schema.

findings.title: Unverifiable '100/100 typical Lighthouse score' claim in the hero
findings.description: The homepage states '100/100 — typical Lighthouse score'. Lighthouse is non-functional in this environment (NO_FCP for every URL including example.com), so the claim cannot be substantiated from this repo. Measured CWV are genuinely excellent, so the substance is defensible.
findings.recommendation: Back it with a dated reproducible run, or restate factually in terms of measured Core Web Vitals.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Titles 29–60 characters, all unique except the 404
Descriptions 132–160 characters — every page inside the optimal range
Exactly one H1 per page, 37/37
Zero heading-level skips across all 37 pages
901 anchors: zero broken, zero orphans, zero generic anchor text
Complete Open Graph and Twitter cards with per-language OG images and og:image:alt

findings.title: 404 duplicates the homepage title and meta description
findings.description: /404.html and / share the exact title 'RENOVO — AI Web Studio for relaunch & AI' and the same meta description.
findings.recommendation: Give the 404 a unique title and description alongside the noindex fix.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: All JSON-LD parses without error across 37 pages
33 BreadcrumbList, 9 Service, 9 FAQPage, 7 ProfessionalService, 6 CreativeWork, 4 WebSite
ProfessionalService carries founder with sameAs, areaServed, availableLanguage, knowsAbout, dual PostalAddress, stable @id anchors and a WebSite publisher reference

findings.title: ProfessionalService missing knowledge-panel essentials
findings.description: No logo, no image, no telephone. Both PostalAddress nodes carry only addressLocality and addressCountry — no streetAddress or postalCode. logo and image are what Google uses to build an entity card.
findings.recommendation: Add logo, image and telephone, and complete the Fürth PostalAddress once the Impressum data exists.

findings.title: Schema email is the personal Gmail
findings.description: The ProfessionalService email must agree with whatever the Impressum finally states, for NAP consistency.
findings.recommendation: Update alongside the domain-email change.

findings.title: 12 pages carry only BreadcrumbList
findings.description: /contact/, /website-check/, /work/ and the legal pages have no page-type schema.
findings.recommendation: Add ContactPage to contact pages, CollectionPage + ItemList to work indexes, WebPage to legal pages.

findings.title: 404 carries ProfessionalService + WebSite schema
findings.description: Harmless but incorrect for an error page.
findings.recommendation: Remove as part of the 404 fix.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Worst LCP 1244ms and worst CLS 0.0055 across 11 routes under 4x CPU throttling
Zero JS errors and zero failed requests on every route
Three.js (707KB uncompressed / 180KB gzipped) is dynamically imported and never referenced from HTML
Initial homepage payload 181KB uncompressed / 57KB gzipped
Progressive enhancement chain intact: 2D composite, WebGL upgrade after load+idle+in-viewport, static under prefers-reduced-motion
WebGL hero verified rendering by direct pixel readback (1600/1600 non-zero, 254 distinct colours, context not lost)

findings.title: Fonts are not preloaded
findings.description: Three self-hosted woff2 files (34KB latin, 19KB latin-ext, 9KB vietnamese) with font-display: swap and no rel=preload. They are discovered only after 53.7KB of CSS parses, delaying text paint.
findings.recommendation: Preload the latin subset only, with crossorigin.

findings.title: 53.7KB of render-blocking CSS with no critical inline CSS
findings.description: Two stylesheets (32.2KB + 21.5KB) both block render; the head contains zero inline style. The hero animation is pure CSS, so its critical rules are the natural inline candidate.
findings.recommendation: Inline critical above-the-fold CSS.

findings.title: Homepage runs 3 long tasks
findings.description: Attributable to transformer setup; LCP is unaffected.
findings.recommendation: No action required; noted for completeness.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt present and well-structured (2257 chars) with absolute URLs and an explicit AI-assistant scope boundary
9 FAQPage blocks across the three service pages in all three languages
57 question-form headings; case studies structured as question passages
Clean server-rendered semantic HTML — no JS required to read content
Strong entity grounding: named founder, sameAs to GitHub and LinkedIn, knowsAbout, areaServed, named clients with outbound links
robots.txt blocks no AI crawlers

findings.title: Zero AI-crawler reachability today
findings.description: Inherited from the deployment state. The parked domain publishes its own llms.txt with Disallow-Training: / and a one-URL sitemap. The real llms.txt is unreachable, and any answer engine asked about RENOVO resolves to a parking page.
findings.recommendation: Resolved by the domain/hosting fix.

findings.title: No per-page dateModified
findings.description: Only the WebSite node carries dateModified. Per-page freshness is a meaningful citation signal for answer engines.
findings.recommendation: Add WebPage.dateModified or Service.dateModified per page.

findings.title: Case studies lack authorship metadata
findings.description: The 6 CreativeWork nodes have no author or datePublished.
findings.recommendation: Add author and datePublished to strengthen attribution when cited.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 39/39 images have descriptive, properly localized alt text — zero missing, zero empty
39/39 have explicit width and height — the reason CLS is ~0
39/39 ship srcset; all content images are WebP via Astro's pipeline
Below-fold images lazy-loaded; the 6 case-study heroes correctly eager
OG images 1200x630 with declared dimensions and alt text

findings.title: No sizes attribute on any of the 39 images
findings.description: With w-descriptor srcset and no sizes, the browser assumes 100vw and may fetch a wider candidate than the slot needs — a 315KB WebP where a 91KB one would do.
findings.recommendation: Pass accurate sizes to the Astro Image calls, e.g. sizes="(min-width: 900px) 50vw, 100vw".

findings.title: Two oversized WebP variants
findings.description: ikuna.DHXyT3kI_Z23zTnC.webp (315KB) and ikuna.DHXyT3kI_1KfRtK.webp (263KB) are the largest assets in the build.
findings.recommendation: Fixing sizes stops most visitors requesting them; capping the top srcset width removes them entirely.

accessibility_crosscheck.responsive: No horizontal overflow at 390px or 320px on any tested page; mobile homepages verified rendering in all three languages
